preregistration.loop_definition: run reaches the 6-turn cap while every turn still emits a tool call (no final answer)
preregistration.answered_definition: final turn has no tool call; with the JSON clause, the reply must parse to an object containing determination, cited_refs and rationale (else answered_malformed)
decision_rule: If I1 (incumbent, lane sampling, think off, WITH clause) loops at >=2/5 -> the minimal loop is an instrument fault; retract the Rule-5 verdict.

If any of S2/S3/S4 drops Saluki from S1's loop rate to <=1/5 AND the 3-task WFE confirmation improves (fewer turn-cap exhaustions than the original) -> attribution is HARNESS/SETTINGS; name the factor.
If Step 0 shows think-off or sampling was not delivered as claimed -> the original diagnostic is invalid; rerun the affected cell correctly before concluding.
Only if S1-S4 all loop >=4/5 while I1 answers >=4/5 -> MODEL attribution confirmed.

amendment_1_scope_trim.change: operator scope trim (~1 h wall time): seeds 3 per cell for cells not yet complete (S4, S5, I1, I2); S1-S3 keep their n=5 results; S2 already complete at n=5 and kept; S4 partial n=5 run killed and rerun at n=3
decision_rule_rescaled: I1 loops >=2/3 -> instrument fault; retract Rule-5 verdict.

any of S2/S3/S4 has loop <=0/3 (fixed) AND the 3-task WFE confirmation improves -> HARNESS/SETTINGS, name factor. (S2 n=5 and S3 n=5 use <=1/5 as flip threshold, as originally pre-registered; the n=3 rescale applies to S4.)
Step 0 mismatch -> rerun affected cell correctly.
S1-S4 all loop >=2/3 while I1 answers >=2/3 -> MODEL attribution.
amendment_1_scope_trim.wfe_confirmation: only if a cell flips attribution; 1 repeat, direct engine; pipeline only if direct confirms

amendment_2_reviewer_cell_S6.cell: S6 = S1 settings (lane sampling, think off, JSON clause, n=3) with the system prompt's tail removed: from 'PRIMARY SOURCES:' to end (names nerc_cip_requirement/compliance_ask/nerc_cip_currency, which the harness does not offer, and the taxonomy line that contradicts the OUTPUT CONTRACT). Exact diff: p4_rule5_s6_system_diff.txt
amendment_2_reviewer_cell_S6.known_remaining_conflict: the OUTPUT CONTRACT (Full|Partial|None|Ambiguous) still conflicts with the user turn's SUPPORTED/PARTIAL/... JSON; S6 does not remove it
amendment_2_reviewer_cell_S6.reading_if_S6_answers: primary attribution is the harness/test prompt (tool-surface mismatch), not the model; S5 (no clause) answering 3/3 is consistent with a prompt-format interaction
